name: applyready
description: Know what's missing before you press submit.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @applyready/server" "npm run dev -w @applyready/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @applyready/shared && npm run typecheck -w @applyready/server && npm run typecheck -w @applyready/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @applyready/shared && npm run build -w @applyready/client && npm run build -w @applyready/server
scripts.qa: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.qa:public-demo: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run build && npm run verify:public-demo && npm run test:e2e:public-demo
